closest_prior_art.UniPixie: Shared solver-agnostic encoding, probabilistic multi-solver outputs, offline solver fitting and amortization already exist.
closest_prior_art.ReconPhys: Single-video feedforward simulation parameters already demonstrated, primarily synthetic free-fall/collision.
closest_prior_art.MatPhys: Material priors, part representation and codebook already exist; paper vs released per-case recipe require protocol separation.
closest_prior_art.EgoPhys: Shared bounded material corrections already reduce dense optimization; sequence-specific CMA-ES remains.

proposed_contribution_not_yet_verified: Observation-conditioned response posterior with explicit force/geometry nuisance uncertainty and observability-aware contraction.
Cross-engine adapters validated on unseen interventions and numerical settings, with irreducible representation-error output.
Distill observational equivalence sets and evaluate intervention response uncertainty without treating optimizer frequency as posterior probability.
